string.name: name
string.value: Evolved Heart Necklace

string.name: desc
string.value:
A powerful necklace that holds the courage of Maple Warriors. It still needs power to evolve, so #cit will disappear after a time.#

The Heart Necklace will evolve through the following stages if you use a class-specific #cMaple Warrior's Heart# to evolve through #Stage 2 and 3#, and then use an #cAdvanced Maple Warrior's Heart# to evolve through #cStage 4 and 5#.
 Stage 1: Inert Heart Necklace
 Stage 2: Evolved Heart Necklace
 Stage 3: Completed Heart Necklace
 Stage 4: Awakened Heart Necklace
 Stage 5: Transcendent Heart Necklace
